definition: A priced offer for one tool (for example Tasks Pro), billed per cycle.
forbidden_synonyms: package, bundle (en); باقة (ar); Paket (de); Forfait (fr); Pacchetto (it)
usage_rule: The Arabic «باقة» is never used for a plan.
review_notes: de Tarif and fr Formule decided at G0 (D-025). Catalogs today: de Plan/Pläne, fr Plans/Forfaits.

definition: A level within a tool's plans (Free, Pro, Business).
usage_rule: Use it only when the level itself is discussed; the level's name (Pro) is usually enough.

definition: A plan negotiated for one workspace, with its own price or limits.
forbidden_synonyms: private plan, enterprise plan (en); باقة خاصة (ar)
review_notes: The spec calls it «باقة» 7 times.

definition: Several tools sold together at one price.
forbidden_synonyms: package (en); باقة (ar); Bündel, Paket (de); Forfait (fr); Pacchetto (it)
review_notes: ar: catalogs use الحزم for both bundles and packages. de: Bündel (current) reads oddly; Bundle is the usual SaaS term. Native review: de, it.

definition: A fixed-scope service engagement OrgTik sells (the website's engagement packages).
usage_rule: The only use of «باقة» in Arabic.
review_notes: fr: Forfait fits a fixed-price engagement, which is why plans become Formule.

definition: A workspace's paid access to one or more tools, renewed every billing cycle.
One tool's entry in a subscription, with its own plan, state and price snapshot.
review_notes: The spec's Arabic definitions say «سطر اشتراك»; «بند» is the MSA term for a line item. Native review: de, it.

definition: One paid user slot in a plan.
review_notes: No app names seats yet. Native review: de, it.

definition: A customer organization's account in the suite: its members, tools, data and billing.
usage_rule: The customer-facing name for the tenant. Company stays the HR/CRM record of a business.
review_notes: Only Chats names it today.

definition: One product of the suite a workspace can subscribe to (Tasks, Files, HR, Sales, Marketing, Chats).
forbidden_synonyms: app, module, system, dashboard (en); تطبيق، نظام (ar)
usage_rule: In product copy. The website's marketing copy ('software modules') stays as it is.
review_notes: The apps say app, system and dashboard for the same thing; SOS calls tools 'systems'.

definition: Free, time-limited use of a paid plan.
usage_rule: The badge reads 'Trial · 5 days'.
review_notes: «تجريبي» is kept for Beta, so the trial uses «تجربة».

definition: A tool released before general availability.
Payments and emails are simulated; nothing is charged.
review_notes: The spec uses «تجريبي» for both Beta and Test mode.

definition: A bill for a subscription or a service.
A document that cancels all or part of an invoice.
A code that applies a discount at checkout.
review_notes: de: catalogs say Gutschein (a voucher, not a code). Native review: de.

definition: A reduction of a price.
A group of countries with a base currency and a price per plan and cycle.
review_notes: ar: Sales mixes مناطق and النطاقات.

definition: ISO code, symbol, decimals (0/2/3) and a rounding rule.
What one unit of a plan costs per cycle.
The unit price for one country, plan and cycle after all pricing rules.
A fixed price for a country, plan and cycle, in the country's currency.
review_notes: Native review: de, fr, it.

definition: An admin-set rate from the zone currency to the country currency, with an effective date (not a live market rate).
A step (0.01, 0.05, 1, 5 …) and a mode (nearest or up), applied only to converted prices.
The price, currency, source and version saved on a subscription line at purchase or renewal.
review_notes: Native review: de, fr, it.

definition: Everything about paying for a subscription: plans, invoices, payment methods.
How often a subscription renews and is charged (monthly, yearly).
Money paid by a customer.
usage_rule: As a section name: Payments.

definition: Money returned to a customer.
usage_rule: A noun on labels and columns. The button is the verb (Refund / استرداد المبلغ / Erstatten / Rembourser / Rimborsa).
review_notes: The catalogs put the verb where the noun belongs (Erstatten, Rembourser, Rimborsa).

definition: A priced offer sent to a customer before they buy.
review_notes: Bug: Sales translates Quote as a text quotation in all four languages (Zitat, Citation, Citazione, اقتباس).

definition: Anyone who can sign in to the suite.
usage_rule: Prefer the specific word (member, employee, customer) when there is one.
review_notes: de: generic form kept (D-025).

definition: A user who belongs to a workspace or a team.
A person on the payroll of the company using HR.
usage_rule: HR only.
review_notes: de: generic form kept (D-025).

definition: The one member who holds a workspace's billing rights; also the creator of a file or folder.
review_notes: de: Files says Besitzer; Inhaber is the usual account term.

definition: A member who manages a workspace's settings and people.
usage_rule: «مدير» means manager and stays for the HR/Tasks manager role.
review_notes: ar: Sales says مدير for admin, which collides with the manager role.

definition: The person an employee reports to (HR, Tasks).
review_notes: Native review: de.

definition: An OrgTik employee using the admin back office (ADM).
A named set of permissions.
The right to see or do one thing.
review_notes: it: HR uses Permessi for both permissions and leave.

definition: A group of members who work together.
review_notes: it: Tasks says squadra (sports). Native review: it.

definition: A unit of a company's organization chart.
review_notes: it: Dipartimento (18) and Reparto (8); Reparto is the usual business word. Native review: it.

definition: A business that buys from the workspace (Sales) or from OrgTik (ADM).
usage_rule: The website's marketing copy keeps 'clients'.
review_notes: en: Sales says Customer, Content and Chats say Client.

definition: A potential customer who hasn't bought yet.
A person at a customer or a lead.
A business record in HR or the CRM.
usage_rule: Not the customer-facing name for the tenant (that's workspace).
review_notes: de: Unternehmen and Firma both used.

definition: A tool's overview page of figures and shortcuts.
usage_rule: Not a name for a tool.
review_notes: ar: Sales says لوحة القيادة; لوحة التحكم is the common MSA term.

definition: A body of work with tasks, members and dates.
One piece of work someone can finish.
Tasks shown as cards in columns.
A container of files and folders.
A stored document, image or video.
A link that gives people outside the workspace access to a file or folder.
A customer's support request.
usage_rule: HR's tickets are internal requests: see the status matrix before reusing the word.
review_notes: fr: Sales says Billets (event tickets).

definition: A sales opportunity with a value and a stage.
review_notes: de: Angebote collides with quote. Native review: de, fr, it.

definition: A coordinated set of marketing posts and ads.
One social-media publication.
usage_rule: Website articles are 'Article'.

definition: A website Insights article.
Time off an employee requests.
review_notes: it: HR mixes Permessi, Congedi and Ferie. Native review: it.

definition: Calculating and paying employees' salaries.
review_notes: Bug: the fr and it catalogs contain the German word 'Lohn'.

definition: One employee's salary statement for a period.
review_notes: Native review: de.

definition: Recorded working time: check-ins, check-outs, absences.
A generated view of figures for a period.
A message the suite shows about something that happened.
Where a tool or workspace is configured.
Destroy permanently, after confirmation.
usage_rule: Only for something that can't be restored.

definition: Take something out of a list or group without destroying it.
usage_rule: Remove a member from a team; the member still exists.
review_notes: fr: one catalog says Supprimer for Remove.

definition: Move out of active lists; can be restored.
usage_rule: The noun (the Archive section) is الأرشيف / Archiv / Archive / Archivio.

definition: Bring an archived or ended item back.
Close without saving or doing anything.
forbidden_synonyms: close, dismiss (en, on dialogs with changes)
usage_rule: Cancelling a subscription is a different action; see the status matrix.

definition: Store the changes on the screen.
usage_rule: One word everywhere; 'Save changes' is dropped (D-025).
review_notes: en: 'Save' and 'Save changes' are both used in 6 apps.

definition: Send something for someone else to review or approve.
review_notes: ar: إرسال means send.

definition: Give other people access.
Ask someone to join a workspace or team by email.
forbidden_synonyms: add (en, when an email is sent)

definition: Move to a higher plan.
review_notes: Native review: de, fr, it (length on buttons).

definition: Open something for changes.
Make a new object that gets its own page.
usage_rule: 'Create project'. For an item added to a list, use Add.
review_notes: en: New, Create and Add New are all used.

definition: Put an item into a list or group.
usage_rule: 'Add member', 'Add tool'.

definition: Download data as a file (CSV, PDF).
Find by typing.
Narrow a list by conditions.
usage_rule: The noun (the Filters button) is فلاتر / Filter / Filtres / Filtri.

definition: A published piece of OrgTik's client work on the website: a shared brief plus the department's own presentation (D-032).
forbidden_synonyms: project, portfolio item (en, in the Website Manager)
usage_rule: In the Website Manager a Work entry is a Case study, never a Project: Project is Tasks' work item. The website's own copy and legacy /projects URLs stay as they are.
review_notes: Added with the D-031 drift review, 2026-09-30

definition: A number, chart or result shown on the website as an example until an approver confirms the real project figure.
usage_rule: Every unapproved figure keeps its visible label. Removing it needs claims:approve (four-eyes). Approved figures are called results.
review_notes: Added with the D-031 drift review, 2026-09-30
